AntiPattern.Bad: Describe scope hosts `let sut, saveOrder, publish, order, now`; `beforeEach` assigns them; second case re-assigns shared `sut` to a different config (leaks state).
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Pile of `let`-variables (inherited `AX_NO_DESCRIBE_LET_PILEUP`). Per-case data built in `beforeEach` without teardown reason (inherited `AX_HOOKS_ONLY_FOR_LIFECYCLE` + `AX_PREFER_FACTORY_OVER_HOOKS`). No unified context type/factory (inherited `AX_ONE_UNIFIED_CONTEXT_PER_FILE`).
AntiPattern.Good: ONE context type + ONE `createOrderLifecycleContext(overrides)` factory used by every case. Each case destructures the fields it uses; failure case overrides one field. No `beforeEach`, no shared `let`s.
